description: Defines a simple linear congruential pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) with functions for generating random numbers within specified ranges, supporting atomic operations for thread safety.

methods.name: prng_state_next_u32
methods.description: Calculates the next 32-bit pseudo-random number state based on current state.

methods.name: prng_state_next_u64
methods.description: Calculates the next 64-bit pseudo-random number state based on current state.

methods.name: prng_state_next_zu
methods.description: Calculates the next size_t pseudo-random number state based on current state, supporting different pointer sizes.

methods.name: prng_lg_range_u32
methods.description: Generates a uniform random 32-bit integer in [0, 2^lg_range), thread-safe if atomic is true.

methods.name: prng_lg_range_u64
methods.description: Generates a uniform random 64-bit integer in [0, 2^lg_range).

methods.name: prng_lg_range_zu
methods.description: Generates a uniform random size_t in [0, 2^lg_range), supporting atomic operations.

methods.name: prng_range_u32
methods.description: Generates a uniform random 32-bit integer in [0, range).

methods.name: prng_range_u64
methods.description: Generates a uniform random 64-bit integer in [0, range).

methods.name: prng_range_zu
methods.description: Generates a uniform random size_t in [0, range).
